sources.title: TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Llama 2 7B - GGUF Model creator: Meta Original model: Llama 2 7B Description This repo contains GGUF format model files for Meta's Llama 2 7B. About GGUF GGUF is a new format introduced by the llama.cpp team on August 21st 2023. It is a replacement for GGML, which is no longer supported by llama.cpp.
